newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada spot gas unchanged from Friday, trade light.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot gas unchanged from Friday, trade light.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices were unchanged on Monday from pre-weekend values with many players staying on the sidelines amid uncertainty over supply, traders said.

Spot gas at Alberta's AECO storage hub was talked at C$1.46/1.47 per gigajoule, the same as Friday. No term gas had moved in early trade, but marketing sources pegged September business at C$1.41/1.43 per GJ, unchanged from late last week.
One Calgary-based trader said the Alberta spot market continued to be slow because of fluctuating available supply volumes on the NOVA Gas Transmission Ltd intra-Alberta pipeline network.

"People are watching field receipts and looking for some consistency -- are they going to be there or aren't they going to be there," the trader said. "One day there will be 12.2 (billion cubic feet per day of gas on the system) and the next there will be 1.8."
Meanwhile, gas at Sumas, Wash. was quoted at US$1.19/1.20 per million British thermal units, again unchanged from Friday.

Sources said upcoming cuts in throughput on Northwest Pipeline to the U.S. Pacific Northwest were expected to be offset by maintance work at Westcoast Energy Inc's Pine River gas plant. The partial outage at the 350 million cubic feet a day plant started on Sunday.
Gas at Westcoast compressor station 2 was said to be fetching about C$1.50 per GJ.

Eastern Canadian points were discussed at US$2.64/2.66, on par with Friday, a trader of eastern gas said. He said the September basis for Niagara and Dawn was talked about a penny higher to US$2.185. ((Jeffrey Jones, Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
